name: Higashijuujou Satsuki
source:
The only daughter of the Higashijujo family, who own a financial conglomerate.

She is hospitalized alone at Nagatsuka Hospital, separated from her parents who are overseas.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_BY/chijyoku/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
